identificationModule.briefTitle: Study of Eltrombopag in Platelet Refractory Thrombocytopenia
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase II Study of Eltrombopag in Platelet Refractory Thrombocytopenia

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This phase II trial is studying the effects of the drug eltrombopag has on thrombocytopenia (low platelet count). Eltrombopag is approved by the FDA for the treatment of thrombocytopenia (low platelet count) in adults who have had an insufficient response to medications such as corticosteroids and immunoglobulins. Eltrombopag is not approved by the FDA (Food and Drug Administration) for the treatment of thrombocytopenia refractory to platelet transfusion and so for this study is considered investigational.

armGroups.label: Eltrombopag
armGroups.description: Eltrombopag 75 mg per day. Possible escalation to 150 mg per day after day 15 lab results. Possible escalation to 300 mg per day after day 29 lab results.

interventions.name: Eltrombopag
interventions.description: 75 mg per day with possible dose escalation to 150 mg per day and 300 mg per day

primaryOutcomes.measure: Determine the likelihood of eltrombopag allowing platelet transfusion independence in patients with platelet refractoriness at doses of 75 mg, 150 mg, and 300 mg per day

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Laboratory diagnosis of platelet refractoriness
* Diagnosis of platelet dependence
* Adequate liver and renal laboratory screening tests

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with thrombocytopenia that are responsive to platelet therapy
* Patients actively receiving intravenous immunoglobulin, plasmapheresis or cytotoxic medications for thrombocytopenia
